title: Shortening Waiting Time for HDB BTO Flats in Support of Marriage and Parenthood Objectives
what_it_is: Shortening Waiting Time for HDB BTO Flats in Support of Marriage and Parenthood Objectives

sections.label: Shorter waiting time BTO flats
sections.summary: HDB has offered close to 11,000 shorter waiting time BTO flats since 2018 and ramped up supply to 23,000 flats per year in 2022 and 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Since 2018, HDB has been offering BTO flats in some projects with shorter waiting times of around three years or less.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: To date, close to 11,000 BTO flats with shorter waiting times have been offered, of which around 7,200 were offered between 2020 and 2022, that is, during the pandemic.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: To meet the strong housing demand, HDB has ramped up the supply of BTO flats to 23,000 flats per year in 2022 and 2023, or a 35% increase from last year, and is also prepared to launch up to 100,000 new flats from 2021 to 2025, if needed.

sections.label: PPHS income ceiling criteria
sections.summary: The $7,000 income ceiling was introduced in August 2021, along with other criteria, to prioritise those less able to afford open market rent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Given the limited supply of PPHS flats, the income ceiling of $7,000 was introduced in August 2021, along with some other criteria, to prioritise those who are less able to afford renting on the open market.

sections.label: More shorter waiting time flats
sections.summary: HDB will work towards launching more shorter waiting time flats of three years or less, subject to site and infrastructure readiness.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Nevertheless, as I have said, even during COVID-19, we launched some 7,200 shorter waiting time flats from 2020 to 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will work towards launching more of such shorter waiting time flats, with waiting times of three years or less, subject to site and infrastructure readiness.

sections.label: Doubling PPHS flat supply
sections.summary: HDB is prepared to look at individual circumstances even if income ceiling is above $7,000, and will double PPHS flat supply.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We recognise that there are housing needs – HDB is prepared, even if the income ceiling is above $7,000, to look at individual circumstances to see how we can help them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will double the supply of PPHS flats by the end of this year and early next year.

sections.label: BTO stock for first-timers
sections.summary: In August this year, a greater percentage of BTO stock was channelled towards first-timer home buyers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Thirdly, in August this year, we channelled an even greater percentage of the BTO stock towards first-timer home buyers.

sections.label: PPHS applications and allocations
sections.summary: Since August 2021, 1,930 families were eligible and applied for PPHS; about 330 selected and were allocated a flat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Since August 2021, 1,930 families were eligible for PPHS and had applied for the scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: About 580 of them were invited to select a PPHS flat, of whom about 330 selected and were allocated such a flat and 250 did not select a flat when invited to do so, which suggests that they did not like the options that were made available to them or they had other housing options.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The remaining 1,350 applicants were unsuccessful in their ballot.
